title: fix(update): show live Doctor phases during maintenance
body:
## What Problem This Solves

During managed updates, Doctor emits phase messages while the updater captures its output until the child exits. JSON updates disable coarse progress too, leaving long maintenance work silent.

Related: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/154636 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/167055.

## User Impact

Operators see bounded core Doctor phases on stderr before activation and pre/post-plugin Doctor children finish, including with `--json`. Messages respect informational log filtering and JSON console style. Stdout remains reserved for the final JSON result.

Phase messages are advisory, not success receipts. Deferred ledger writes, schema ownership, cancellation, cleanup, and terminal diagnostics retain their existing behavior. Pre/post-plugin terminal diagnostic replay can repeat a phase already shown live.

## Why This Change Was Made

The existing Doctor stderr decoder now recognizes a producer-owned vocabulary of fixed core phases and sends only those bounded messages to the existing CLI diagnostic output. Plugin labels, unknown text, private suffixes, controls, and overlong lines are not forwarded live. Synchronous display exceptions cannot cancel the child through its output observer; the CLI's existing asynchronous broken-output policy is unchanged.

Both activation and fresh pre/post-plugin Doctor use this callback. Candidate validation keeps its existing output contract. The related contributor PR addresses finalization integrity heartbeats and broader repair behavior; this repair covers the shared core-phase visibility gap without replacing that work.

## Evidence

- Merged as [`11091f0bf62f93465c03aae211a3ae185cde88ae`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/11091f0bf62f93465c03aae211a3ae185cde88ae) on 2026-10-29 at 06:59:33 UTC. [Final-head CI 40830155733](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/40830155733) completed successfully: **55 successful jobs, 26 skipped, zero failures**.
- Implementation head: `39e2d45393d42ae7dbf549de01226e947437a9dd` (signed commits; normal commit hooks passed).
- Behavioral RED: [CI 40824878705, job 123285901098](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/40824878705/job/123285901098) tested checkpoint `6dee5007acfc259d1d705c0238994c511b981d16` in merge `ae5c81f1d4074b78aab6b06d9fa00cacc4850d5d`. The real delegated child was alive after emitting its phase; the expected operator stderr assertion failed because output was empty. All 11 existing sibling cases passed.
- The same held-child regression checks JSON-mode display with deferred ledger writes, then normal child cleanup, custody release, ledger flush, and complete JSON after release. The fixtures retain these assertions. Corrections rename a shadowing local, use Vitest’s context-bearing `it.for` for the two fresh-Doctor cases, and initialize the real child with the same test-owned temporary root as its parent before importing the receipt writer. The writer and its safe-path check remain active.
- Additional tests cover fragmented UTF-8, bounded recognized phases, private/unknown text rejection, info/quiet and console style, original output-observer stop/throw behavior, and synchronous display failure. Gated fresh-Doctor cases cover both pre/post-plugin paths, output capture, delayed completion callbacks, and retained terminal replay.
- Behavioral GREEN at final `39e2d453`: [job 123302852947](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/40830155733/job/123302852947) passed the real held-child case and all 11 delegation siblings, both fresh pre/post-plugin cases, and all eight new display cases. The three owning test files passed 12, 93, and 32 cases respectively. [Job 123302852983](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/40830155733/job/123302852983) passed all six new framing/privacy/observer cases. Logs bind tested merge `19eb0262` (`39e2d453` into `e125921a`).
- The previously failing CLI-update test-type lane now [passes on the final head](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/40830155733/job/123303304307). Production types, all lint lanes, and the test-line ratchet also passed. The ordinary exact-head GitHub gates completed successfully before the squash merge.
- Earlier fixture corrections aligned Vitest context handling, the real child temporary-root contract, and an optional assertion diagnostic. No production behavior or safety assertion was weakened. Predecessor `5595c4b9` also passed the behavioral cases; its overall run was cancelled by the necessary diagnostic correction push and is not claimed green.
- Pinned formatter, whitespace/signature and normal commit hooks passed. Selected autoreview completed scoped-clean; independent full source review and bounded source-equivalence review covered the measurement-owner extraction and mechanical fixture corrections. [Claw revision 3](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187372#issuecomment-6489330827) reviewed exact `39e2d453` with zero findings and no before-merge blocker.
- Production: net +95 lines for the typed phase/privacy contract and shared diagnostic callback. Tests: net +384 literal-LF lines, exactly covered by the independent allocation; the shared scalar is unchanged.

The real-child case uses controlled native delegation, not actual Doctor migration work or an installed interactive CLI. The fresh-Doctor sibling cases hold a mocked command open. No live deployment proof is claimed. No production deployment was performed for this PR.

### Review follow-through

The identified test-type failure is corrected; its final-head CLI-update type lane and the complete required CI workflow passed. Installed-CLI/actual-migration proof is explicitly deferred: the accepted native child boundary regression exercises the changed live-output projection and JSON/ledger/cleanup ownership, with controlled fresh-Doctor sibling coverage. It does not run actual migration work. The healthy production host has no further maintenance scope in this cycle, and no shipped or live Doctor proof is claimed.
